integrity: An exact integral discrete-Morse certificate and a standalone standard-library checker accompany the proof; the 2021 withdrawn claim is not used as a premise.
scientific_limitations: An exact result for the three-row nine-column grid only; no all-width homotopy theorem or independently audited result is claimed. The complete September 2026 primary paper could not be inspected, leaving possible numerical-prior-work overlap.
title: The nine-column grid matching complex is a wedge of 163 eight-spheres
